blocks.text: Calcium carbonate (CaCO₃) and calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)₂) are added to acidic soils to increase pH (neutralize acidity), making the soil more suitable for crop growth. Calcium and magnesium are essential plant nutrients. Calcium is crucial for cell wall development, while magnesium is a central atom in chlorophyll, which is vital for photosynthesis. Compounds like calcium nitrate or magnesium sulphate (Epsom salts) can be used as fertilizers.
